children: Huddlestock Fintech AS ("Huddlestock" or "the Company") has entered into a partnership agreement with Firi AS ("Firi"), for a tied-agent solution utilizing Huddlestock's regulatory infrastructure.

The partnership is built around Huddlestock's MiFID II regulatory framework and gives Firi access to established infrastructure for regulated investment services. Firi will communicate on scope and timing of new services separately.

As outlined in previous communications, the commercial structure comprises two components: a fixed monthly base fee and a variable fee based on trading volume. The partnership is subject to standard regulatory notifications to relevant national financial supervisors.

We are very pleased to be entering into a partnership with Huddlestock. Huddlestock gives us access to a regulatory framework that is already in place. That allows us to develop our offering responsibly while we keep our focus on product and customer experience
" says Thuc Hoang, CEO and Founder, Firi AS.
Speaking with Thuc and his team, there was a clear alignment from early on. Both teams share the same direction and are excited about the journey ahead
" says Ramtin Matin, Interim CEO, Huddlestock Fintech AS.
Firi AS is the largest cryptocurrency exchange in the Nordics, with approximately 430,000 retail customers and operations in Norway, Sweden and Denmark.

Huddlestock is a European Investment-as-a-Service provider enabling financial institutions and digital platforms to launch and scale investment services efficiently and in full regulatory compliance. Through its BaFin-regulated entity, Huddlestock GmbH, the company provides access to a comprehensive liability umbrella and European passporting framework, allowing partners to offer regulated investment services without requiring their own financial license. Combining regulatory infrastructure with a modular, partner-based ecosystem, Huddlestock enables clients to build tailored investment solutions while significantly reducing time-to-market and operational complexity. Huddlestock Group also includes Visigon, a Nordic based consulting company with deep expertise in capital markets and treasury technology.

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-11-26 14:25 CET.
